name: Veryl
description: A fisherman with greasy blond hair who claims to have seen the Gitrog and who boasted of kissing an angel.

timeline.summary: Elder Kalim announces that he has seen the Gitrog and that fishing on the lake is suspended; he has written to the Church and suggests Mia write her father.
timeline.quote: The Elders convened last night, and we decree that fishing on the lake is suspended until further notice.

timeline.summary: Mia accuses the villagers of having killed her sheep a few at a time; Kalim insists everyone has seen the Gitrog and must feed it.
timeline.quote: There is no Gitrog! You destroyed my pen and slaughtered my herd!

timeline.summary: The Gitrog's tongue hurls Veryl off the ship and he disappears into the water.
timeline.quote: Veryl went flying backward off the ship, screaming through the air, and disappeared with a splash into the water.

pages_say.description: A fisherman with greasy blond hair who claims to have seen the Gitrog and who boasted of kissing an angel.
